channel.title: MicroStudio engineering notes
channel.description: Practical, evidence-led notes about narrow technical controls, built with synthetic or public information and explicit scope boundaries.

item.title: A clean spreadsheet needs an exception ledger, not just deduplication.
item.description: Five controls for cleaning a sanitized business spreadsheet without hiding rejected rows, duplicate decisions, broken totals or manual corrections.

item.title: Cloud price catalogs need a change ledger, not another scrape.
item.description: A fixed-scope audit for two authorized AWS or Azure retail-pricing snapshots, with normalized keys, explicit changes, SQLite tables and a deterministic receipt.

item.title: A clean MQL5 compile is a receipt, not a trading result.
item.description: A practical MQL5 delivery note about zero-warning compile evidence, default-off execution, module boundaries, deterministic review gates and explicit broker assumptions.

item.title: Orders, refunds and inventory: twelve controls before the ledger closes.
item.description: A four-export reconciliation control for orders, fulfillments, refunds and inventory, with stable exceptions, source evidence and three cross-output invariants.

item.title: PO, invoice and packing list: fourteen checks before ERP entry.
item.description: A practical three-document reconciliation control: compare purchase commitments, supplier charges and packing evidence with stable exceptions and source-line traceability.

item.title: Amazon Settlement V2: five controls before the file changes.
item.description: A practical control note for Amazon's 2026 Settlement V2 migration: field mapping, settlement totals, amount breakdowns, timing checks and deterministic exception evidence.

item.title: A webhook needs three records, not one success log.
item.description: A runnable, synthetic Node.js proof for signed webhook ingestion, idempotent replay handling, visible exceptions and transactional side effects.

item.title: Webhook 返回 200，为什么仍可能重复下单？
item.description: 用可运行的合成 Node.js 证明解释 Webhook 原始报文验签、数据库幂等、异常队列、事务型 outbox 与逐次对账。
